claude.rationale: This was a whole-company reverse triangular merger with DigitalGlobe surviving as an indirect wholly owned subsidiary, so its customer-facing product line (Earth imagery/geospatial analytics) and the operating processes that produce it — including the NGA satellite-imagery Enhanced View contract carried forward "as an operating asset of the surviving subsidiary" — crossed the boundary together, yielding no product-vs-process mismatch (gap_45=0). Likewise the operational processes moved with the people: "Continuing Employees" were retained with protected compensation/benefits and credited service, and the surviving entity kept its operations intact, so process and organization aligned coherently at closing (gap_56=0). The board/officer slate was replaced with a mixed roster drawn from both DigitalGlobe and MDA leadership, supporting imprint-share at T1; the FOCI Security Control Agreement and reverse termination fee are risk carve-outs, not substitutes for a transferred substrate.
